axioms.name: Experimental.P06_14.upstream_sech_cosine_transform
axioms.meaning: Cosine transform of the genuine hyperbolic secant; an upstream analytic identity independent of the requested scaled beta pole functional and coupled pencil.

typed_coverage: Concrete beta series/finite harmonics, an explicit scaling operator, and the independent secant transform. No equivalence between conflicting printed normalizations is assumed.
missing_domain_interfaces: A coherent unscaled beta rational functional, the exact change of variables and Jacobian, its monomial and pole formulas, comparison constants C2/C4 and the actual coupled matrix.
repair_gates: The source proof itself contains a “Wait” normalization correction and obtains a factor 2 differing from the displayed monomial formula. Resolve definitions and Jacobian first.
Do not combine −μ(R(4t)) with an incompatible −4w(2v) formula as axioms.
Cone positivity, pole alignment and integer arithmetic must use one repaired convention throughout.
validation: Static source review only; no Lean process, build or axiom audit run.
